motions.name: login
motions.line: What kind of variables led to such a result...?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: If we don't stand our ground, something terrible will happen!

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: I knew I was gonna get shot! I-I just didn't know how to prevent it from happening...

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: According to my prediction, walking side-by-side with you will result in bad luck, so we should keep some distance— Whoa! W-why is there a bucket of water here?! Ugh... Now I'm all soaked!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Humph, I told you we'd win this time~!

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Why am I carrying so many weapons? To increase my rate of accuracy, duh! The more I shoot, the more likely the enemy gets hit!

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Happy New Year! Oh, this red packet is for me?! Huh? You want me to guess how much money is inside? Puh-lease, that would totally ruin the surprise!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Look, a pretty decent haul, right?!

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: I can already see our victory!

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Today, the Commander will be wearing... red! Humph, bingo.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: According to my prediction, you're about to entrust some treasure of utmost importance to me. That's fine, hand it over!<>Huh?! The treasure is this ring?!<>H-hang on a second! Forget what I just said! No, I'm not saying no! It's just... that wasn't romantic at all! We have to do it again!!!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Compared to predicting the future, it's much more fun to look forward to the unknown future together with you— Hold on! In two hours, the bakery at the end of the street will have a limited quantity of very tasty pastries coming fresh out of the oven! Commander, let's get in line!
